words.note: 當 love 是名詞，表示對家人、朋友、伴侶或動物的溫暖感情時，affection 很自然。它通常比 romantic love 更廣，也較少帶強烈激情意味。
words.example: She has great affection for her grandparents.
words.exampleZh: 她對祖父母有深厚的感情。

exercises.original: Her love for her grandparents is obvious in the way she calls them every evening.
exercises.zh: 她對祖父母的愛意從她每晚打電話給他們這件事就看得出來。
exercises.upgrade: affection · 愛意；感情；親愛

options.explanation: affection = 愛意；感情。grandparents + regular caring contact 表示溫暖親情，affection 最自然。
passion = 強烈熱情。通常更強烈，常用於活動、理想或浪漫關係，不適合普通祖孫親情。
obsession = 迷戀；執著。帶過度、不健康意味。
admiration = 欣賞；敬佩。可以敬佩祖父母，但不等於親密愛意。
enjoyment = 享受；樂趣。是對活動或經驗的愉快感，不是對人的情感。
romance = 浪漫愛情。和祖孫關係完全不合。

exercises.original: The dog responded to the family's love with complete trust.
exercises.zh: 這隻狗以完全信任回應一家人給牠的愛意。
exercises.upgrade: affection · 愛意；感情；親愛

options.explanation: devotion = 忠誠深愛。可形容長期忠誠，但這裡是家人給狗的溫暖愛意。
affection = 愛意。family + dog + trust 是典型親愛、溫暖感情語境。
romance = 浪漫愛情。人與寵物不適用。
attraction = 吸引力。不是親愛感情。
pleasure = 愉悅。不是對狗的情感。
admiration = 敬佩。可能欣賞動物，但不等於親愛。

exercises.original: He spoke about his childhood home with obvious love and warmth.
exercises.zh: 他談起童年住所時流露出明顯的愛意和溫暖感情。
exercises.upgrade: affection · 愛意；感情；親愛

options.explanation: affection = 深厚感情。childhood home + warmth 表示帶懷念的溫暖感情。
obsession = 執迷。語氣過度且常負面。
desire = 渴望。不是懷舊感情。
romance = 浪漫情愛。不能自然描述對舊居的情感。
enjoyment = 樂趣。不是對地方的情感連結。
attraction = 吸引。可能喜歡某地方，但不如 affection 表達長期情感。

words.note: 當 love 表示溫和、持久的喜愛，而不是極強烈或浪漫的愛時，可用 fondness。常見結構是 fondness for。
words.example: He has a particular fondness for old jazz records.
words.exampleZh: 他特別喜愛舊爵士唱片。

exercises.original: She has always had a love for old bookstores and can spend hours browsing in them.
exercises.zh: 她一直很喜愛舊書店，可以在裡面逛上幾小時。
exercises.upgrade: fondness · 喜愛；鍾愛；好感

options.explanation: fondness = 喜愛。old bookstores + pleasant repeated interest 是溫和而持久的喜愛。
devotion = 忠誠投入。對書店語氣太強。
obsession = 痴迷。can spend hours 不足以表示不健康執迷。
romance = 浪漫愛情。對書店不合。
attraction = 吸引力。可表示被吸引，但不如 fondness 表達長期喜愛。
loyalty = 忠誠。不是喜愛某類場所的自然詞。

exercises.original: His love of spicy food began when he was a teenager.
exercises.zh: 他對辣食的喜愛從青少年時期開始。
exercises.upgrade: fondness · 喜愛；鍾愛；好感

options.explanation: passion = 熱愛。比原句所需更強烈。
fondness = 喜愛。fondness for food 是自然搭配，表示持久偏好。
devotion = 奉獻／忠誠。通常不用來形容食物偏好。
adoration = 崇愛；極度喜愛。語氣太強。
romance = 浪漫。無關。
attachment = 依戀。可形容人或有情感連結的事物，但對辣食不如 fondness 自然。

exercises.original: She remembers her first teacher with great love, although they have not met for decades.
exercises.zh: 她帶着深厚好感記得第一位老師，雖然兩人已數十年沒有見面。
exercises.upgrade: fondness · 喜愛；鍾愛；好感

options.explanation: fondness = 深厚好感。remember someone with fondness 是自然固定搭配。
desire = 渴望。不是回憶中的溫暖好感。
romance = 浪漫愛情。沒有浪漫關係線索。
pleasure = 愉悅。可以 remember with pleasure，但不能完整表達對老師的長期喜愛。
obsession = 痴迷。語氣過強且負面。
attraction = 吸引。容易帶身體／浪漫意味，不合。

words.note: 當 love 是名詞，強調長期忠誠、付出和堅定感情時，可用 devotion。常用於伴侶、家庭、信仰、事業或責任。
words.example: Her devotion to her family never changed.
words.exampleZh: 她對家人的深愛和投入從未改變。

exercises.original: His love for his wife was shown by years of care during her illness.
exercises.zh: 他多年照顧患病妻子，展現出對她深厚而忠誠的愛。
exercises.upgrade: devotion · 深愛；忠誠；全心投入

options.explanation: devotion = 深愛與忠誠。years of care during illness 明確表示長期投入和忠誠。
fondness = 喜愛。太輕，不能表達多年照顧的深度。
attraction = 吸引。無法涵蓋忠誠照顧。
enjoyment = 享受。完全不合。
admiration = 敬佩。可以敬佩伴侶，但不是多年付出的愛。
interest = 興趣。太弱。

exercises.original: The nurse's love for her patients was reflected in the extra care she gave them every day.
exercises.zh: 護士每天額外照顧病人，反映出她對病人的全心投入。
exercises.upgrade: devotion · 深愛；忠誠；全心投入

options.explanation: affection = 愛意。可能存在，但 extra care every day 更強調持續投入。
devotion = 全心投入。professional caregiving + extra daily care 很適合 devotion。
romance = 浪漫愛情。不合專業護理關係。
attraction = 吸引。無關。
fondness only = 單純喜愛。力度太弱。
pleasure = 愉悅。不是對病人的承諾。

exercises.original: Her love for music led her to practise the violin for hours every day for twenty years.
exercises.zh: 她對音樂的熱愛和投入令她二十年來每天練小提琴數小時。
exercises.upgrade: devotion · 深愛；忠誠；全心投入

options.explanation: devotion = 全心投入。hours every day for twenty years 是長期投入的決定性線索。
casual fondness = 一般喜愛。和二十年高強度練習不符。
attraction = 吸引。不能表達長期努力。
amusement = 消遣。太輕。
romance = 浪漫愛情。無關。
liking = 喜歡。力度不足。

words.note: adore 是強烈、自然的動詞，可表示非常愛某人，也可口語表示極喜愛某物或活動。比 like 強很多。

exercises.original: She loves her grandchildren and talks about them constantly.
exercises.zh: 她非常疼愛孫兒，經常談起他們。
exercises.upgrade: adores · 非常愛；極喜愛

options.explanation: adores = 非常愛。grandchildren + talks about them constantly 支持強烈親愛感情。
enjoys = 享受。通常接活動或事物，不能完整表達對孫兒的深愛。
admires = 敬佩。可以欣賞某人，但不等於疼愛。
likes = 喜歡。力度明顯較弱。
values = 重視。可以重視家人，但不是情感性的『很愛』。
prefers = 更喜歡。需要比較對象，且意思不同。

exercises.original: I love that little café; I go there almost every weekend.
exercises.zh: 我非常喜歡那間小咖啡店，差不多每個週末都去。
exercises.upgrade: adore · 非常愛；極喜愛

options.explanation: cherish = 珍愛。通常用於人、記憶或非常珍貴的事物，對咖啡店可勉強但不如 adore 口語自然。
adore = 極喜愛。little café + frequent visits 是常見口語強烈喜愛。
devote myself to = 投身於。不是喜歡某地方。
admire = 欣賞。較像欣賞設計、成就或品質，不是一般強烈喜愛。
respect = 尊重。無關。
need = 需要。不是喜愛。

exercises.original: He loves old detective films and watches one nearly every night.
exercises.zh: 他非常喜愛舊偵探電影，幾乎每晚都看一部。
exercises.upgrade: adores · 非常愛；極喜愛

options.explanation: adores = 非常喜愛。watches one nearly every night 顯示強烈喜好。
respects = 尊重。不是娛樂偏好。
depends on = 依賴。不是喜愛。
values formally = 正式地重視。搭配不自然。
tolerates = 忍受。和 love 相反。
accepts = 接受。力度太弱。

words.note: cherish 表示深深愛護並珍視某人、關係、回憶或事物。它比 adore 多一層『把它視為珍貴』的意味。
words.example: She cherishes the time she spends with her family.
words.exampleZh: 她十分珍惜和家人相處的時間。

exercises.original: He loves the letters his mother wrote him and keeps them in a special box.
exercises.zh: 他非常珍愛母親寫給他的信，把它們放在一個特別的盒子裡保存。
exercises.upgrade: cherishes · 珍愛；珍惜

options.explanation: cherishes = 珍愛。keeps them in a special box 表示把信視為珍貴之物。
enjoys = 喜歡／享受。可以享受閱讀，但不能表達珍藏價值。
admires = 欣賞。可欣賞寫作，但不是珍愛。
prefers = 偏好。需要比較。
uses = 使用。無關。
follows = 跟隨。無關。

exercises.original: She loves the memories of summers spent with her grandparents.
exercises.zh: 她十分珍惜和祖父母一起度過暑假的回憶。
exercises.upgrade: cherishes · 珍愛；珍惜

options.explanation: adores = 極喜愛。可口語表示很喜歡，但 memories 通常更自然用 cherish。
cherishes = 珍惜。memories 是最典型的 cherish 搭配之一。
enjoys greatly = 非常享受。回憶可以帶來享受，但不能表達『珍視保存』。
respects = 尊重。不能自然修飾 memories。
prefers = 偏好。無比較對象。
needs = 需要。意思不同。

exercises.original: They love their friendship and make time for each other even when life is busy.
exercises.zh: 他們十分珍惜彼此的友誼，即使生活忙碌仍會抽時間見面。
exercises.upgrade: cherish · 珍愛；珍惜

options.explanation: cherish = 珍惜。make time for each other despite being busy 表示把友誼視為珍貴。
enjoy = 享受。可以享受友誼帶來的快樂，但不如 cherish 表達重視與維護。
admire = 欣賞。friendship 本身通常不這樣搭配。
prefer = 偏好。需要比較。
tolerate = 忍受。意思相反。
require = 需要。無關。

words.note: be fond of 表示對某人、食物、活動或事物有溫暖而持久的喜愛。比 love 弱一些，也比 like 更有親切感。
words.example: She is very fond of classical music.

exercises.original: He loves gardening, especially growing herbs and tomatoes.
exercises.zh: 他很喜歡園藝，尤其喜歡種香草和番茄。
exercises.upgrade: is fond of · 喜歡；鍾愛

options.explanation: is fond of = 很喜歡。gardening 是日常興趣，語氣溫和自然。
is devoted to professionally = 專業投入。題目只是興趣，沒有職業投入。
is dependent on = 依賴。不是喜愛。
is obsessed with necessarily = 必然痴迷。語氣過度。
is responsible for = 負責。無關。
is afraid of = 害怕。相反。

exercises.original: She loves her elderly neighbor and often checks whether he needs anything.
exercises.zh: 她很喜愛那位年長鄰居，經常看看他是否需要幫忙。
exercises.upgrade: is fond of · 喜歡；鍾愛

options.explanation: admires from afar = 遠遠欣賞。沒有這種距離感。
is fond of = 喜愛。neighbor + caring behavior 是溫暖親切的好感。
depends on = 依賴。無關。
is attracted to = 被吸引。容易帶浪漫／身體意味，語境不支持。
is committed legally to = 法律上承諾。無關。
tolerates = 容忍。和 love 相反。

exercises.original: My grandfather loves telling stories about his childhood.
exercises.zh: 我祖父很喜歡講童年故事。
exercises.upgrade: is fond of · 喜歡；鍾愛

options.explanation: is fond of = 喜歡。be fond of + -ing 是自然結構，表示持久喜好。
is bound to = 必然會。不是喜好。
is obliged to = 有義務。相反，像被迫做。
is responsible for = 負責。無關。
is tired of = 厭倦。相反。
is wary of = 提防。無關。

words.note: be devoted to 表示對某人、家庭、事業或活動長期忠誠和投入。比 love 更強調承諾和持續付出。
words.example: He is devoted to his family.
words.exampleZh: 他深愛家人，並全心投入家庭。

exercises.original: She loves her family and consistently puts their needs before her own.
exercises.zh: 她深愛家人，而且一直把家人的需要放在自己之前。
exercises.upgrade: is devoted to · 深愛；忠於；全心投入

options.explanation: is devoted to = 深愛並全心投入。consistently puts their needs first 明確是長期承諾。
is fond of casually = 只是喜歡。力度不足。
is attracted to = 被吸引。家庭語境不合。
enjoys greatly = 非常享受。不能表達責任和犧牲。
admires only = 只是敬佩。太窄。
depends entirely on = 完全依賴。不是愛的同義詞。

exercises.original: He loves his work with homeless families and has stayed in the field for more than twenty years.
exercises.zh: 他非常投入服務無家者家庭的工作，二十多年來一直留在這個領域。
exercises.upgrade: is devoted to · 深愛；忠於；全心投入

options.explanation: enjoys casually = 一般享受。二十多年投入明顯不只是休閒喜好。
is devoted to = 全心投入。more than twenty years 是長期承諾的強線索。
is amused by = 覺得有趣。語氣錯誤。
is attracted to = 被吸引。不能表達職業奉獻。
prefers over everything = 比一切更偏好。語義和搭配都不自然。
tolerates = 忍受。相反。

exercises.original: The couple clearly love one another; they have supported each other through decades of hardship.
exercises.zh: 這對伴侶顯然深愛彼此；數十年來他們一直互相支持，渡過困境。
exercises.upgrade: are devoted to each other · 深愛；忠於；全心投入

options.explanation: are devoted to each other = 彼此深愛且忠誠。decades of hardship + mutual support 是典型 devotion。

options.text: are merely fond of each other
options.explanation: are merely fond of each other = 只是喜歡。merely 明顯削弱感情。
are interested in each other = 對彼此有興趣。太弱。
enjoy each other greatly = 非常享受彼此陪伴。不能完整表達長期忠誠。
admire each other professionally = 專業上互相欣賞。語境不是工作。
depend on each other financially = 經濟依賴。原句沒有此含義。

words.note: 當 love 的對象是活動、事業、學科、理念或興趣，而且重點是強烈熱情和投入時，可用 be passionate about。通常不拿來代替一般親情。
words.example: She is passionate about environmental education.

exercises.original: He loves photography and spends most weekends taking pictures and learning new techniques.
exercises.zh: 他非常熱愛攝影，大部分週末都在拍照和學習新技巧。
exercises.upgrade: is passionate about · 熱愛；對……充滿熱情

options.explanation: is passionate about = 熱愛。spends most weekends + learning techniques 表示強烈興趣和投入。
is fond of mildly = 有點喜歡。力度太弱。
is devoted romantically to = 浪漫地深愛。對攝影不合。
is dependent on = 依賴。不是熱情。
is responsible for = 負責。無關。
is tolerant of = 容忍。相反。

exercises.original: She loves improving access to education and has built her career around that goal.
exercises.zh: 她熱愛改善教育機會，並以這個目標建立自己的事業。
exercises.upgrade: is passionate about · 熱愛；對……充滿熱情

options.explanation: enjoys casually = 一般享受。built her career around that goal 顯示遠超休閒喜好。
is passionate about = 熱愛。career + goal + sustained commitment 很符合 passion。
is amused by = 覺得有趣。太輕。
is attached romantically to = 浪漫依戀。對理念不合。
is afraid of = 害怕。相反。
is indifferent to = 漠不關心。相反。

exercises.original: The students love robotics and voluntarily stay after school to work on their designs.
exercises.zh: 這些學生非常熱愛機械人技術，自願放學後留下來改進設計。
exercises.upgrade: are passionate about · 熱愛；對……充滿熱情

options.explanation: are passionate about = 熱愛。voluntarily stay after school 顯示強烈熱情和主動投入。
merely tolerate = 只是容忍。和自願留下工作相反。
are legally committed to = 法律上有義務。沒有法律責任。
are afraid of = 害怕。相反。
are dependent on = 依賴。不是喜愛。
are indifferent to = 不在意。相反。

words.note: 當 love 表示很喜歡某種活動、經驗、食物或娛樂，而且重點是從中得到很大樂趣時，可用 enjoy greatly。它通常不適合表達對人的深愛。
words.example: She greatly enjoys walking by the sea.
words.exampleZh: 她非常享受在海邊散步。

exercises.original: I love spending quiet Sunday mornings reading by the window.
exercises.zh: 我非常享受星期日早上安靜地坐在窗邊閱讀。
exercises.upgrade: greatly enjoy · 非常享受；非常喜歡

options.explanation: greatly enjoy = 非常享受。spending quiet mornings reading 是活動與體驗，重點是樂趣。
am devoted to = 全心投入。語氣太像長期使命或承諾。
adore romantically = 浪漫地愛。活動不適用。
cherish as a memory = 當作回憶珍惜。這是正在進行的習慣，不是回憶。
depend on = 依賴。無關。
admire = 欣賞。不能自然接 spending... 表示享受。

exercises.original: She loves swimming in the lake on warm summer evenings.
exercises.zh: 她非常享受在溫暖夏夜到湖裡游泳。
exercises.upgrade: greatly enjoys · 非常享受；非常喜歡

options.explanation: is devoted to professionally = 專業投入。沒有職業或使命線索。
greatly enjoys = 非常享受。swimming + warm summer evenings 是典型愉快活動。
cherishes as an object = 當作物件珍愛。swimming 是活動。
admires = 欣賞。不能表達參與活動的樂趣。
respects = 尊重。無關。
needs = 需要。不是喜歡。

exercises.original: They love trying new restaurants whenever they travel.
exercises.zh: 他們旅行時非常享受嘗試新餐廳。
exercises.upgrade: greatly enjoy · 非常享受；非常喜歡

options.explanation: greatly enjoy = 非常享受。trying new restaurants 是反覆帶來樂趣的活動。
are devoted to morally = 在道德上奉獻。搭配和意思都不合。
cherish permanently = 永久珍愛。活動不適合。
admire from afar = 遠遠欣賞。不是親身體驗。
depend on = 依賴。無關。
tolerate = 忍受。和 love 相反。

words.note: treasure 作動詞時表示把某人、關係、時光或物件視為非常珍貴。和 cherish 很接近，但 treasure 往往更直接強調『珍貴價值』。
words.example: I treasure the time I get to spend with my family.
words.exampleZh: 我十分珍惜和家人相處的時間。

exercises.original: She loves the handmade necklace because it was the last gift from her grandmother.
exercises.zh: 她十分珍愛那條手製頸鏈，因為那是祖母送給她的最後一份禮物。
exercises.upgrade: treasures · 珍愛；珍視

options.explanation: treasures = 珍愛。last gift from her grandmother 表示物件具有極高情感價值。
enjoys = 喜歡／享受。不能完整表達珍貴紀念價值。
admires only = 只是欣賞。太表面。

exercises.original: He loves every hour he gets to spend with his young children.
exercises.zh: 他非常珍惜和年幼孩子相處的每一個小時。
exercises.upgrade: treasures · 珍愛；珍視

options.explanation: adores only = 只是非常愛。對孩子可用 adore，但 every hour 更自然強調珍惜時間。
treasures = 珍惜。every hour he gets to spend 是典型珍視有限相處時間。
enjoys casually = 一般享受。casually 太弱。
depends on = 依賴。無關。
admire = 敬佩。詞形也不合第三人稱。
prefers = 偏好。需要比較。

exercises.original: They love the friendship they have maintained since childhood.
exercises.zh: 他們非常珍視自童年延續至今的友誼。
exercises.upgrade: treasure · 珍愛；珍視

options.explanation: treasure = 珍視。since childhood 表示這段關係具有長期、珍貴價值。
tolerate = 容忍。和 love 相反。
require = 需要。不是情感。
prefer = 偏好。沒有比較。
admire professionally = 專業上欣賞。不是友誼語境。
depend on financially = 經濟依賴。原句沒有這個意思。

falseSynonyms.zh: 喜歡不等於一般的 love like = 喜歡 like 和 love 有重疊，但通常力度較弱。不能把所有 love 都直接降成 like，尤其是深愛、忠誠或珍愛語境。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I like this song. I love my family.

falseSynonyms.zh: 欣賞；敬佩不等於一般的 love admire = 欣賞；敬佩 admire 強調欣賞某人的能力、品質或成就，不等於情感上的愛。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can admire someone without loving them.

falseSynonyms.zh: 吸引；吸引力不等於一般的 love attraction = 吸引；吸引力 attraction 表示被某人或某物吸引，可能是外表、興趣或浪漫吸引；它不等於穩定的愛。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Attraction may begin a relationship, but it is not the same as love.

falseSynonyms.zh: 渴望；慾望不等於一般的 love desire = 渴望；慾望 desire 強調想得到、想做或強烈渴望，不能取代親情、友愛或忠誠的 love。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Desire is wanting; love is an emotional bond.

falseSynonyms.zh: 痴迷；執著不等於一般的 love obsession = 痴迷；執著 obsession 通常表示過度、難以控制的專注，常帶負面意味。強烈 love 不一定是 obsession。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Deep love can be healthy; obsession suggests excessive fixation.

falseSynonyms.zh: 浪漫愛情；浪漫關係不等於一般的 love romance = 浪漫愛情；浪漫關係 romance 只涵蓋愛情中的浪漫層面，而 love 還可用於家人、朋友、活動、地方和事物。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Romance is one type of love, not the whole concept.

falseSynonyms.zh: 可愛的；美好的不等於一般的 love lovely = 可愛的；美好的 lovely 是形容詞，表示令人喜愛、漂亮或愉快；love 是名詞或動詞，詞性和用法不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The garden is lovely. I love the garden.

falseSynonyms.zh: 愛人；情人；愛好者不等於一般的 love lover = 愛人；情人；愛好者 lover 是名詞，指愛人或某事物的愛好者，不是 love 這個情感或動作本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is a music lover. She loves music.
